text:
Maya: hi all, first week here! trying to prep a smoke for an integration but I don't see the 'Feature Flags' admin tab in Console (prod). can someone advise who to contact or what I need?
Zoe: welcome Maya! :wave: For prod edits we require a privileged action. do you have your okta email so infra can check perms?
Maya: maya.k@redwood.ai. I can edit staging flags but prod UI is missing the admin controls.
Tom: hey Maya, quick FYI we locked down prod flag writes last quarter. infra manages temporary grants via the PRIV workflow. it's intentional to avoid accidental rollouts.
Maya: the task is low risk: flip rollout_ui_banner to 5% for 15m to validate telemetry. will revert immediately.
infra-bot: IAM lookup: maya.k -> groups: console-read, eng-intern. Missing permission: featureflag.modify (console-admin). Policy: PRIV-required for prod. See https://docs.redwood.ai/security/privileged-actions
Zoe: easiest path: open a PRIV ticket with justification + monitoring links and tag me. I can review same-day for short smoke tests.
Maya: submitted PRIV-101: "temp prod toggle rollout_ui_banner 5% (15m)" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-101. included dashboards and rollback plan.
Tom: tagging @Zoe for approval. also include the exact time window so infra can schedule TTL.
Zoe: approved PRIV-101. infra, please grant a 30m temp role to maya.k (we'll auto-revoke early if needed).
infra-bot: grant command: `grant-temp --user=maya.k --role=console-admin --env=prod --ttl=00:30 --ticket=PRIV-101 --note="new-hire smoke"`
infra-bot: grant complete. audit_id=aud-d4e2f1. expires in 30m.
Maya: thanks! used the Console scheduled toggle UI to set 5% for 15m. smoke runs started.
sec-bot: reminder: all privileged actions are logged and will be reviewed. retention = 1y.
Maya: tests green, reverted to 0%. huge thanks for the quick help :smile:
Zoe: added a line to onboarding: "If you need prod flag writes within week 1, file PRIV ticket on day 0." saves time for future new hires.
Tom: noted in platform runbook with link to PRIV-101 for trace.
Maya: closing the loop, appreciate the assist!
